en: Black‑and‑white photograph of a cobblestoned town square with a large stone church or chapel on the left, an adjacent civic-looking building with a small tower in the center, and lower townhouses on either side. In front of the church stands an elaborate Baroque Marian or plague column with statues around a tall obelisk-like shaft. People in late‑19th or early‑20th‑century clothing walk or stand in the square; a horse‑drawn cart is at the left edge. German shop signs are visible on the buildings.
